First environment audit (#138) written to `audit/latest.md` (copy of `audit/0001.md`).

Measured facts, with sources in `.session/startup.json`, `.session/history/manifest.json`, `iterations/0005/tasks.json` and `engine.yml`:
- Three startup documents, 3,860 bytes total. Token measure is `unmeasured`: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is not configured for trusted staging.
- No exports, no history records, no staged streams, no `iterations/NNNN.json` record. Only `iterations/0005/tasks.json` exists.
- Audit limits differ: profile 30 turns / 10 min (`policy/profiles.yml`) vs task 80 turns / 60 min (`iterations/0005/tasks.json`).

Not measured: tokens per role and model, context fill, step wall time, loop waiting, parallelism. Reasons: no streams, no records, no API key.

Proposals for the Policymaker are in `audit/0001.md` under "Proposals": decide which audit limits govern, provide the API key for the startup measure, and stage streams for the next audit.

No managed definitions were changed. Only `audit/` was written. No scripts were added.

## Discoveries
- The audit profile and the task limits disagree on turns and timeout; see `audit/0001.md`.
